project.title: dxtr_cleaner
project.tagline: A Rust/GPUI desktop cleanup utility focused on macOS usability first.

summary.short: dxtr_cleaner is a Rust desktop cleanup application built with GPUI, currently focused on making macOS cleanup reliable and easy to use before expanding platform scope.
summary.long: The project prioritizes macOS cleanup correctness, usability, layout quality, and maintainable Rust core architecture, with Windows support planned after the Mac experience is stabilized.
